interpretation.marker_occurrences: supported lexical predicate occurrences in source sentences
interpretation.eligible_pairs: ordered typed candidate pairs with a non-negated predicate between endpoints
interpretation.extracted_rows: rows emitted by the production extractor; must equal eligible_pairs
interpretation.endpoint_diagnostics: For sentences containing a supported predicate marker, these counters show whether subject and object candidate types were present and ordered correctly; they do not relax extraction requirements.
interpretation.diagnostic_examples: At most five source-grounded examples per diagnosis and predicate. Candidate spans are limited to twelve per example and sentence text to 600 characters; examples retain source identity and offsets.
interpretation.coverage_limit: This audit measures only the current predicate lexicon and typed candidates; it does not estimate semantic relations expressed with unsupported wording.
